name: 3741-longdecode-7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of one a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process engine, no Ray.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, hidden 4096, intermediate 11008, 32 query and 32 KV heads, head_dim 128, native context 4096; fp16, 6.74B parameters, 13.5 GB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams 160 then 32, warmup 20%, cooldown 10%, each point bounded at 480 requests with an 1800 s safety cap. The 160-stream point is the primary one and is `benchmarks[0]`.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, `request_format: plain`, `stream: true`, greedy (`temperature: 0.0`), no logprobs, `ignore_eos`; every request is exactly 256 prompt tokens and exactly 256 output tokens (min=max on both), so the run is one operating point repeated.
purpose: A streaming 7B chat assistant serving short prompts with long replies to 160 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# ERA CONSTRAINT: every key here becomes an `AsyncEngineArgs(**kwargs)` keyword, and this
# engine's `EngineArgs` is a dataclass with a fixed field list -- a key it does not have is a
# TypeError at construction, not an ignored line. Do not add keys from a later vLLM.

model: NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
block-size: 16
swap-space: 4
seed: 0
